summary: Google DeepMind announced SL2T, a sign-language-to-text translation model now powering ASL-to-English dictation features in Gboard and Live Transcribe on Pixel 11.

practices.reason: A newly released specialized model for pose-to-text sign language translation with a stated benchmark score could be investigated for accessibility-focused vision/language pipelines.
practices.quote: SL2T achieves a remarkable zero-shot score of 70 BLEURT, which is significantly higher than any previously reported score.

practices.reason: The FLEURS-ASL benchmark and BLEURT scoring methodology described could inform how a team measures translation quality for similar sequence-to-text tasks.
practices.quote: SL2T is the most capable sign language translation model to date according to key benchmarks like FLEURS-ASL (sd-test), which assesses ASL to English translation quality.
